description: A student notebook doing EDA and Prophet forecasting on a July-2021 scrape of Booking.com guest reviews for 819 Belgian properties (hotels, hostels, B&Bs, apartments), one row per review with review date, reviewer nationality, score, property average score, and a tags field encoding trip type, party composition, room type and length of stay. Source is a Kaggle CSV scraped from booking.com/reviews/be; the repo commits only the notebook. For ABNB an analyst would use the Kaggle CSV (if obtained by a human) as a dated Booking.com review stream for Belgium 2018-2021 to compare review-count seasonality and nationality/cross-border mix against our Inside Airbnb reviews-based stays index; the notebook itself only shows that the data exists and what its schema is. Single country and a 2021 endpoint make it archival context, not a nowcast input.
issues: No licence in repo or stated for the Kaggle dataset; data is a scrape of booking.com (ToS question for a human). Raw CSV needs Kaggle login: NOT pulled. Notebook time-series work is on avg_rating of one hotel (a constant per property, so the series is effectively a review-count proxy) and is analytically weak; only the schema and date range are useful. Belgium only; ends 2021-07-19. Not the Portugal hotel-booking-demand dataset.
